owner_split.boundary: Core owns the /v2/astra/* backend contract and ledger/reward invariants. Astra owns client sign-in, bearer-token forwarding, refresh behavior, and UI integration.

routes.purpose: Account-mode capability discovery; returns wallet_required=false and endpoint map.
Creates an account-bound single-use run token.
Computes reward server-side from account-bound run evidence; writes account ledger operation astra_reward.
Compatibility preflight; account reward-image generation is explicitly disabled until account-owned artifact path exists.
Charges account credits once; repeated matching idempotency key replays without a duplicate debit.

security_and_compatibility: Every route requires a verified HavnAI account bearer token and returns Vary: Authorization through the /v2 account route stack.
Client request bodies must not include account_id, wallet, reward amount, or balance.
Legacy wallet-era /astra/* routes remain intact for older clients but are not the commercial account path.
Legacy Astra session tokens cannot authorize /v2/astra/* account routes.
Account data is stored in account_astra_* tables and account_credit_ledger, not legacy wallet columns.
Legacy wallet-earned Astra rewards are not silently migrated; future migration must use the HAVN-18 wallet-link/import path.

covered_behaviors: bearer account session works without wallet and unauthenticated session returns 401
generate-preflight is bearer-only and explicitly disabled for account reward images
legacy Astra session token cannot authorize account routes
reward is server-timed, capped, and written to account ledger without legacy wallet run writes
fake duration is rejected as run_too_short and burns the token to prevent replay
run token is bound to the issuing account
spend is idempotent and debits account ledger once
failed spend is audited and not replayed as success

remaining_client_acceptance: Astra client must use shared HavnAI account sign-in or redirect handoff and forward the account bearer token.
Astra browser acceptance must prove signed-in refresh keeps reward eligibility without MetaMask signature prompts.
Astra guest play must remain available while reward/spend UI clearly requires sign-in.
Wallet-linked prior Astra balances/history need explicit import/link verification, not silent transfer.
scope_note: This evidence proves the core API contract and server-side reward/spend invariants. It does not close Astra client integration or game-side browser acceptance.
